data.title: Recursive Socratic Questioning (Top-Down Decomposition & Bottom-Up Synthesis) and SoDa Socratic Style Chain-of-Thoughts
data.description: Authoritative L400 architectural specification synthesizing Qi et al.'s Recursive Socratic Questioning (Top-Down Confidence-Gated Decomposition and Bottom-Up Hint-Guided Synthesis) with SoDa (Socratic-Guided Dialogue Chain-of-Thoughts) across the 8 Socratic Principles for in-trajectory self-correction, SFT distillation, and Google Cloud ADK 2.0 LoopAgent orchestration.
